origin.description: First occurrence of each collation class, in the original order. The first missing string is kept. A leading BOM is removed.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vectors, or objects coerced with as.character. NA stays missing. The string "NA" is text.

arguments.name: opts_collator
arguments.text: A named list from stri_opts_collator, or NULL. Extra arguments are passed through stri_opts_collator.

origin.details: First occurrence of each collation class, in the original order. The first missing string is kept. A leading BOM is removed. One leading U+FEFF is removed before compare, sort, order, rank, unique, and duplicated, and the strings those functions return are stripped. stri_sort_key keeps that character and drops only the terminating NUL of the ICU key.
origin.value: The vector stringi returns for this function. JSON null in the captured check is NA.
origin.example: cat("stri_unique(c('a', 'b', 'a', NA, NA)) returns a, b, NA.\n")

translation.description: First occurrence of each collation class, in the original order. The first missing string is kept. A leading BOM is removed.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, a number, or a list of those. None is an empty vector. None inside a list is NA.

arguments.name: opts_collator
arguments.text: A dict of supplied settings, or None. Keywords are merged with stri_opts_collator. normalisation is stored as normalization.

translation.details: First occurrence of each collation class, in the original order. The first missing string is kept. A leading BOM is removed. One leading U+FEFF is removed before compare, sort, order, rank, unique, and duplicated, and the strings those functions return are stripped. stri_sort_key keeps that character and drops only the terminating NUL of the ICU key. Collation uses PyICU.
translation.value: A list. A bare string is a length-one list. NA is stringi._na.NA.
translation.example: print("stri_unique([\"a\", \"b\", \"a\", NA, NA]) returns a, b, NA.")
